description: Required repository checks. `cargo xtask checks --profile fast` runs the CI set; `extended` needs release builds, openssl, java or time; `qualification` entries point at registered protocols and never report success from the runner. See docs/formal/verification-strategy.md.

checks.scope: Rust formatting of the workspace
checks.unchecked: Formatting only.

checks.scope: Locked compilation of every workspace target
checks.unchecked: Research packages under tools/ are separate workspaces and not compiled.

checks.scope: Workspace unit, integration and end-to-end tests, including the delivery-kernel differential test, the gate fixtures and server tests graded by the Python query oracle
checks.unchecked: Excluded research packages; physical power loss; multi-host networks; qualification workloads.
checks.negative_controls: xtask/tests/gates.rs fixture defects; see xtask/mutants.json for code mutants

checks.scope: Clippy on every workspace crate and target with warnings denied, including the core's panic and unchecked-arithmetic restrictions
checks.unchecked: Research packages under tools/ and the nightly fuzz crate are outside the workspace.

checks.scope: Hexagonal dependency rule over declared and resolved cargo metadata
checks.unchecked: Module-level structure inside a crate; composition roots that still contain adapters.

checks.scope: Core dependency allowlist, denied categories, build script, features, required attributes, syntactic guards, transitive closure
checks.unchecked: Determinism of individual functions; block comments and strings in the source guard.

checks.scope: The qualification runner's limits, ownership marker and negative controls
checks.unchecked: Hard filesystem quotas; environment-scrubbing children.

checks.scope: Seeded source and the independent rate oracle, with injected overrate, corruption and missing-source controls
checks.unchecked: Real Spindle offer timing and end-to-end admission.
checks.fixtures: seed 0xA11FA001, ten identities, two seconds; SHA-256 a6e5fca6...

checks.scope: The soak protocol's decision rule, with one injected defect per gate that must fail exactly that gate
checks.unchecked: The harness's measurement collection; exercised only by a soak run.

checks.scope: The independent delivery oracle and its mutation controls
checks.unchecked: The oracle's own adapter contract: it grades transcripts, not processes.
checks.negative_controls: dropped ACKed record, duplicate, replaced bytes, early forget

checks.scope: The independent query and rate oracle and its pagination, rate and completeness mutants
checks.unchecked: Latency and freshness; the oracle is exact-scan only.

checks.scope: Relative links, heading fragments, Mermaid syntax, marked diagram copies, JSON syntax, duplicate ADR numbers
checks.unchecked: Whether prose is true.

checks.scope: The documentation checker's valid and broken fixtures
checks.unchecked: Checker coverage beyond its fixtures.

checks.scope: Codex hook behavior
checks.unchecked: Live hook activation and trust.

checks.scope: Agent-telemetry record contract
checks.unchecked: Development tooling only; no product claim.

checks.scope: Agent-telemetry observer CLI
checks.unchecked: Development tooling only; no product claim.

checks.scope: Every registered counterexample names a reproducer test that exists and a fix commit that exists
checks.unchecked: Whether the reproducer still reproduces the original defect against the old code.

checks.scope: proptest properties of every semantic kernel, stated from the ADRs and views independently of the code (2,000 cases each)
checks.unchecked: Adapters and composition roots; inputs outside the generators' ranges (Kani covers the full integer ranges).
checks.negative_controls: M-PROP-GROUP, M-PROP-PAGE, M-PROP-TEXT, M-PROP-RET-BYTES in xtask/mutants.json

checks.scope: Replays every committed fuzz corpus and regression input through the fuzz target bodies on stable Rust
checks.unchecked: Only committed inputs; coverage-guided search is fuzz-smoke (extended).

checks.scope: turmoil simulation of delivery against the real server router and store under link failures, latency, partitions and lost answers (6 seeds)
checks.unchecked: Process crashes (delivery-faults covers them); TLS; the commit thread runs on a real OS thread, so runs are not fully deterministic.

checks.scope: Every registered semantic mutant must be caught by its named checker
checks.unchecked: Mutants not in the registry; see cargo-mutants calibration.

command: cargo build --release --locked --workspace --bins --examples && for s in clean server-kill node-kill outage; do for seed in 1 2; do python3 -B tools/qualification/delivery_faults.py --scenario $s --seed $seed --seconds 20 --keep || exit 1; TLA_JAR="$PWD/target/tools/tla2tools.jar" python3 -B formal/delivery/trace_check.py target/alpha-delivery-$s-$seed/transcript.jsonl || exit 1; rm -rf target/alpha-delivery-$s-$seed; done; done && ! python3 -B tools/qualification/delivery_faults.py --scenario clean --seed 3 --seconds 8 --mutate drop-recovered
checks.scope: Real server and Spindle processes under SIGKILL and outage, graded by the delivery oracle, and each transcript validated by TLC against the DeliveryOwnership model; plus the drop-recovered negative control
checks.unchecked: Physical power loss; more than three Spindles; latency.
checks.bounds: three Spindles, 20 s per scenario, seeds 1 and 2

checks.scope: TLC over the delivery ownership model: Safe passes, EarlyAck and LostCopy produce counterexamples
checks.unchecked: The model is not the Rust code; fault-run traces are validated against it by trace-model.

checks.scope: TLC over the research transport credit model
checks.unchecked: Research model only.

command: echo 'qualification protocol: run by hand under explicit scope (see the protocol; runner.py with history_tier.py)' >&2; exit 3
checks.scope: Registered qualification: docs/experiments/benchmarks/alpha-phase4-history-protocol.md
checks.expected: a run record under the registered protocol; this entry never reports success
checks.unchecked: Everything until a run record exists.

command: echo 'qualification protocol: run by hand under explicit scope (see the protocol; runner.py with outage_drain.py)' >&2; exit 3
checks.scope: Registered qualification: docs/experiments/benchmarks/alpha-phase5-outage-protocol.md
checks.expected: a run record under the registered protocol; this entry never reports success
checks.unchecked: Everything until a run record exists.

command: echo 'qualification protocol: run by hand under explicit scope (see the protocol; runner.py with stress_tier.py)' >&2; exit 3
checks.scope: Registered qualification: docs/experiments/benchmarks/alpha-phase5-stress-protocol.md
checks.expected: a run record under the registered protocol; this entry never reports success
checks.unchecked: Everything until a run record exists.

command: echo 'qualification protocol: run by hand under explicit scope (needs root on a disposable systemd host)' >&2; exit 3
checks.scope: Registered qualification: docs/PRODUCT-CONTRACT.md
checks.expected: a run record under the registered protocol; this entry never reports success
checks.unchecked: Everything until a run record exists.

checks.scope: Trace validation of a real fault-run transcript against the DeliveryOwnership model, with early-forget, lost-ACKed-record and resend-after-forget controls that must be rejected
checks.unchecked: Sequences, bytes and credentials (the model has none); node process crashes (the model assumes the upstream copy survives).

checks.scope: cargo-mutants on fabric-core and fabric-app with both packages' tests; every survivor must be listed as equivalent with a reason
checks.unchecked: Adapters and composition roots are not mutated.
checks.negative_controls: an empty equivalence list must fail (recorded in the milestone record)

checks.scope: Kani bounded model checking of the fabric-core proof harnesses (crates/fabric-core/src/proofs.rs), including panics and arithmetic overflow
checks.unchecked: Results hold within each harness's unwinding bound; the retention harness covers up to three Segments and the gap-text harness 4-byte messages.

checks.scope: cargo-fuzz (libFuzzer) for 60 s per target from the committed corpus: batch decoding, query requests, frame-log recovery
checks.unchecked: Time-boxed search; no crash in 60 s is not proof of absence.
checks.negative_controls: skipping batch validation crashes batch_identify on the empty input at once (recorded in the milestone record)

checks.scope: cargo-deny: RustSec advisories, yanked crates, licence allow-list, wildcard requirements and sources (deny.toml)
checks.unchecked: Advisories published after the run; duplicate versions are only reported.
checks.negative_controls: the policy without ISC fails (exit 4; recorded in the milestone record)

checks.scope: Source-based line and region coverage of the workspace tests; a report, never a gate on a percentage
checks.unchecked: Coverage says what ran, not what was asserted; binaries started as subprocesses are not instrumented.

checks.scope: Locked WASM compilation; native workspace compilation cannot establish browser compilation.
checks.unchecked: Locked WASM compilation; native workspace compilation cannot establish browser compilation.

checks.scope: Deterministic selected UI text contrast; no whole accessibility conformance claim.
checks.unchecked: Deterministic selected UI text contrast; no whole accessibility conformance claim.

checks.scope: Exact package shell identities and deliberately corrupted assets; no installed-system acceptance claim.
checks.unchecked: Exact package shell identities and deliberately corrupted assets; no installed-system acceptance claim.
